Maria Chen: quick sync — saw a weird pattern in continuous-batcher telemetry last night, creating thread to capture queries and next steps :eyes:
Jon Park: saw it too. queue_depth spiked ~30s while avg_batch_util dropped from 82% -> 25%. kernel fallback increased for short sequences.
Kevin Liu: I pulled a short profile and KV cache hit-rate dropped at the same time. suspect cache churn causing many small batches. flamegraph: https://internal.artifacts/fg/1934
Tara Nguyen: can we add a dashboard panel for 'small_batch_fraction' (batches with token_count <= 8)? that's where utilization tanked.
Samir Patel: agree. quick promql I sketched:
```
# fraction of batches with size <=8 over 5m
sum(rate(batch_count{batch_size=~"[1-8]"}[5m])) / sum(rate(batch_count[5m]))
```
Jon Park: nice. also want token/sec per worker:
```
sum(rate(batch_tokens_processed[1m])) by (worker) / sum(rate(worker_cpu_seconds_total[1m])) by (worker)
```
Maria Chen: for kernel selection telemetry we should expose "fallback_reason" tag (e.g., seq_len_mismatch, quant_incompat, fallback_timeout). currently we only see fallback counts.
Kevin Liu: added a counter `kernel_fallback_total{reason="..."}` in the branch. will push.
metrics-bot: alert muted: batcher_queue_depth_high (was firing ~1934567000-1934567300). will include in dashboard panel.
Tara Nguyen: for dashboard layout proposal: row1 = cluster-level KPIs (queue depth, batch utilization, tokens/sec); row2 = breakdowns (small_batch_fraction, kv_cache_hit_rate, kernel_fallback_by_reason); row3 = per-worker hotspots + recent traces.
Samir Patel: also add a datatable for most frequent prompt prefixes (top 20) — those interact badly with prefix caching and cause small batches.
Jon Park: question on token budget targets: current target_per_request_token_budget=512 might be too small for some workloads; should we surface per-route token_budget as a telemetry metric?
Maria Chen: yes. expose `route_token_budget` and emit it in traces (so we can correlate route config -> batch patterns).
Kevin Liu: perf regressed in nightly after 2.1.2 -> 2.1.3 deploy? deploy-bot says: 
"deploy-bot: started rollout redwood/batcher:2.1.3 at 1934567600"
Jon Park: timeline matches. I'll run bisect on kernel selection flags (switch off new heuristic) and replay traces.
Tara Nguyen: for dashboard panels, suggested grafana queries:
```
# batch utilization (tokens used / capacity)
sum(rate(batch_tokens_processed[1m])) / sum(rate(batch_capacity_tokens[1m]))

# kv cache hit rate
sum(rate(kv_cache_hit_total[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_request_total[5m]))
```
Samir Patel: I can add a tiny realtime panel with a moving 30s window to catch transient spikes (use annotate with last 2 hours).
Maria Chen: action items:
- Kevin: deploy kernel_fallback_total + reason tag (owner) — ETA: today EOD
- Samir: small_batch_fraction panel + 30s realtime (owner) — ETA: tomorrow morning
- Tara: dashboard layout PR + panel queries (owner) — ETA: tomorrow noon
- Jon: bisection + perf regression repro (owner) — ETA: tomorrow EOD
- Maria: add route_token_budget telemetry to tracing (owner) — ETA: next week
Jon Park: ping if you want me to run replay; I have a trace capture ready.
Kevin Liu: will push fallback metric now, dropping a note in #eng-runtime when done.
metrics-bot: note: saved panel templates to /dashboards/eng-runtime/batcher-telemetry-v1.json
Maria Chen: thanks all :chart_with_upwards_trend: Let's reconvene after the panels land and we have a repro trace.
